style: Tilt-shift miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, like a handcrafted stop-motion film set: tiny realistic figurines with soft matte skin and real fabric clothing, finely sculpted props, rich natural materials, warm volumetric sunlight, shallow depth of field with one sharp band across the middle of the frame and creamy blur at the top and bottom, gentle atmospheric haze, cinematic colour grade, warm amber highlights, soft blue shadows, high detail, 35mm film grain.
negative_video: Bright saturated tones, overexposed, static frame, blurry details, subtitles, text, logo, watermark, painting, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed hands, extra fingers, malformed limbs, fused fingers, messy background, three legs, many people in the background, walking backwards, sudden cuts, morphing faces, flicker, zoom

characters.photographer: the photographer: a 41-year-old woman, 175 cm, 70 kg, slim, salt-and-pepper hair in a low bun, rectangular black glasses, charcoal quilted gilet over an oatmeal roll-neck sweater, olive canvas field trousers, brown hiking boots, holding a weathered tan mirrorless camera with a silver top plate and a worn brown leather strap up to her eye
characters.familyFall: a young family of four: a 34-year-old mother with shoulder-length dark brown hair in a mustard knit cardigan and jeans, a 36-year-old father with short black hair and a close beard in a rust flannel shirt and khaki chinos, a 6-year-old girl with curly dark pigtails in a red corduroy dress and white tights, a 3-year-old boy with fine dark hair in navy dungarees, and a golden retriever puppy
characters.priyaSam: an engaged couple: Priya, a 29-year-old woman, 163 cm, 55 kg, long wavy black hair, warm brown skin, small gold hoop earrings, a dusty-rose wrap dress and white sneakers; and Sam, a 31-year-old man, 180 cm, 76 kg, short curly brown hair, light stubble, a light blue oxford shirt with rolled sleeves and tan chinos
characters.newbornFamily: new parents with their newborn: the mother, 31, 165 cm, auburn hair in a loose bun, cream knit sweater; the father, 33, 183 cm, short dark blond hair, sage green shirt; their 2-week-old baby asleep, swaddled in a soft blush-pink wrap
characters.partyGuests: a small group of friends at a 30th birthday party: the birthday woman, 30, short black bob, sparkly gold dress, holding a sparkler; three friends in colourful casual party clothes dancing and laughing

locations.fallPark: a small round floating island of autumn park drifting in the sky above soft clouds: a grassy top carpeted with fallen orange and yellow leaves, four sculpted autumn maple and oak trees in orange, red and gold, a red and white gingham picnic blanket with a wicker basket, a few small pumpkins, the island's underside a craggy rock and soil cone with hanging roots. Lighting plan: 1 PM autumn sun high from the upper left, warm 4500 K, dappled leaf shadows on the blanket, soft fill from the pale blue sky. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/2.8, elevated three-quarter view looking down about 30 degrees.
locations.glassStudio: the Snap glass studio: an endless seamless studio sweep in soft pastel lavender fading to white at the top, a smooth matte lavender floor with soft reflections, large frosted translucent glass objects with faint iridescent periwinkle and pink edges glowing softly from inside. The top third of the frame is calm, empty, evenly lit lavender space with no lamps, no light sources and no orbs visible. Lighting plan: soft even diffused studio light from above and all sides, no hard shadows, soft contact shadows under every object and figure, cool 6000 K with a warm glow from inside the glass. Camera: 60 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/4, low three-quarter view slightly above figure height.
locations.studioIsland: a small round floating island in the sky above soft clouds, with a cosy cutaway photo studio built on its grassy top like a dollhouse: a honey wooden floor, two cream walls with a big window, a white seamless paper backdrop, a softbox light on a stand, a round beanbag with a soft blanket, a potted plant, a small shelf of baby props. The island's underside is a craggy rock and soil cone. Lighting plan: 8 AM soft morning sun through the window, cool 5500 K, pale peach and blue morning sky, gentle haze. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/2.8, elevated three-quarter view looking down about 30 degrees.
locations.lakeIsland: a small round floating island in the sky above golden clouds, with a tiny lake on its grassy top: a round pond of clear blue water, a white wooden wedding arch woven with blush roses and greenery beside it, two short rows of white folding chairs with a few guests, an aisle of scattered petals, a willow tree. The island's underside is a craggy rock and soil cone. Lighting plan: 5:30 PM golden hour, low warm 3200 K sun from the right, long soft shadows, pink and apricot sky, glowing rim light. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/2.8, elevated three-quarter view looking down about 30 degrees.
locations.partyIsland: a small round floating island in the night sky above violet clouds, with a wooden deck on its grassy top: warm string lights zig-zagging overhead between four wooden poles, colourful bunting, a small table with a tiered birthday cake and glowing candles, balloons, a pine tree. The island's underside is a craggy rock and soil cone. Lighting plan: 9 PM friendly night, deep indigo and plum sky with stars, warm 2700 K glow from the bulbs and candles, never black. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/2.8, elevated three-quarter view looking down about 30 degrees.
locations.openingWide: a wide view of four small floating islands drifting in a bright morning sky full of soft clouds, at different heights and distances: a cosy cutaway photo studio island, an autumn park island with orange trees, a lakeside island with a white wedding arch, and a party island with string lights. Lighting plan: 8 AM morning, pale blue sky warming to peach near the clouds, soft sun from the upper left. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift lens, wide establishing shot, the islands small in frame, lots of sky.
locations.finaleWide: a wide view of four small floating islands drifting in a twilight sky above violet clouds, all their tiny lights glowing warm: a cutaway photo studio with a lit window, an autumn park with a lantern, a lakeside island with a white wedding arch and fairy lights, and a party island with string lights. Lighting plan: twilight just after sunset, deep royal blue at the top fading to violet and soft pink, first stars, warm practical lights. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift lens, wide pull-back, islands small in frame, lots of sky in the upper half.

style_glass: Tilt-shift miniature photography of tiny realistic figurines in a clean premium studio: soft matte skin, real fabric clothing, frosted glass props, shallow depth of field, airy pastel lavender and white palette, calm and minimal, high detail, no text, no logos.
